reason: A general utility plugin that configures and persists HTTP/SOCKS proxy settings, injecting them into process.env so spawned installation commands inherit the proxy.

summaries.zh: 用于配置并持久化 HTTP、HTTPS 和 SOCKS 代理，并将代理环境变量注入插件安装所启动的子进程。
summaries.en: Configures and persists HTTP, HTTPS, and SOCKS proxy settings and injects the proxy environment variables into child processes started for plugin installation.

capabilities: Configures HTTP, HTTPS, and SOCKS proxy environment variables
Persists proxy settings to a file under $DSH_HOME
Provides a settings page for enabling, editing, and clearing proxy configuration
Automatically removes in-process proxy variables when stopped
